\documentclass[border=3pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.markings,positioning}

\definecolor{routeblue}{HTML}{2563EB}
\definecolor{routegreen}{HTML}{15803D}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  stage/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=1.8cm,minimum height=.8cm},
  decoration={markings,
    mark=at position .28 with {\node[draw=routeblue,fill=white,font=\scriptsize,above=2pt]{queued};},
    mark=at position .72 with {\node[draw=routegreen,fill=white,font=\scriptsize,above=2pt]{running};}}
]
  \node[stage] (in) {Input};
  \node[stage,right=5cm of in] (out) {Output};
  \draw[very thick,postaction={decorate}] (in) to[bend left=20] (out);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
